arStrings.szText:
You inflict non-Boss enemies near you with {c_important}Aura of Misfortune{/c}{if:SF_9}, Slowing them by {c_number}[{SF_11}*100]%{/c}{/if}. When an affected monster would attack, they have a {c_random}[{SF_0}*100|%|]{/c} chance to stumble and do nothing instead.{if:SF_9} 

You gain {c_number}[{SF_10}*100|+%|]{/c} Movement Speed.{/if}
Unlocked at Coven's Favor Tier III and purchased from an Altar of Witchcraft at the Tree of Whispers.
{c_important}Aura of Misfortune{/c} now increases your Movement Speed by {c_number}[{SF_10}*100]%{/c} and Slows enemies by {c_number}[{SF_11}*100]%{/c}.
